body_markdown:
On 15 September, BW LPG CEO Kristian Sørensen participated in the panel discussion “Multi-Sector Strategy: Agility in a Changing Market” at Marine Money Oslo 2026.


The panel explored how shipping companies can navigate an increasingly complex and volatile market. Kristian highlighted the importance of remaining agile and opportunistic when investing, divesting and raising capital, while maintaining a disciplined, long-term approach.


The discussion also addressed several themes particularly relevant to LPG and energy shipping. Geopolitical developments are playing an increasingly important role alongside traditional supply-and-demand fundamentals, reshaping trade flows and potentially influencing tonne-mile demand. At the same time, high asset prices, long lead times and the risk of future oversupply make fleet renewal and capital allocation an increasingly complex balancing act.


In a cyclical industry where market conditions can shift quickly, agility and financial flexibility remain essential.
